convertibility_reason: Uses standard MT5 trade libraries (Trade.mqh, SymbolInfo.mqh, etc.) but implements custom pivot calculation logic not based on built-in indicators. Has multi-variant SL/TP fallback logic and loss-based lot reduction (DcF), plus global variable state tracking for SL modification. No iCustom calls but the pivot logic is entirely hand-computed from MqlRates rather than using a built-in indicator handle.

derived_values.name: ProfitSell
derived_values.formula: Support1 if TgtProfit=1,3; Support2 if TgtProfit=2,4; Support3 if TgtProfit=5

derived_values.name: ProfitBuy
derived_values.formula: Resist1 if TgtProfit=1,3; Resist2 if TgtProfit=2,4; Resist3 if TgtProfit=5

derived_values.name: TargetBuy (first target for SL modification)
derived_values.formula: Pivot if TgtProfit<=2, Support1 if TgtProfit>=3

derived_values.name: TargetSell (first target for SL modification)
derived_values.formula: Pivot if TgtProfit<=2, Resist1 if TgtProfit>=3

long.left: (lo2[0] < bLevel OR cl2[0] <= bLevel) AND op2[0] > bLevel

short.left: (hi2[0] > sLevel OR cl2[0] >= sLevel) AND op2[0] < sLevel

params.description: ModSL moves SL to breakeven (open price + spread) when first target level (TargetBuy/TargetSell stored in global variable tg1) is reached. Only one modification then global variable is deleted.

other_exits: Intraday exit: if isTradeDay=true and hour==23, closes any open position (buy or sell) at market with 3x spread deviation

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots>0: use fixed Lots value. If Lots==0: calculate as FreeMargin * MaxR / 1000. Then if DcF>0 and consecutive losses>1: reduce lot by (lot - lot * losses / DcF). Final lot is normalized to SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP and clamped between SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN and SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses bar[2] (op2, hi2, lo2, cl2) and bar[1] (cl1) to detect pivot level touches. Buy signal: bar[2] penetrated below bLevel (low or close below, open above) AND bar[1] close recovered to >= bLevel. Sell signal: bar[2] penetrated above sLevel (high or close above, open below) AND bar[1] close fell back to <= sLevel. This is a mean-reversion pivot bounce strategy. If primary SL/TP fails the minimum stops level check, a second variant is attempted: Buy uses SL=Support2/TP=Resist3; Sell uses SL=Resist2+Spread/TP=Support3+Spread. SL modification (ModSL): when price reaches first target (TargetBuy for buys, TargetSell for sells), SL is moved to breakeven (entry price +/- spread). The deviation is set to Spread*3 (not a fixed pip value). Global variable 'tg1' tracks the first target for SL modification and is deleted after modification or if position no longer exists.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Pivot levels are calculated from previous D1 bar OHLC - need D1 data feed alongside current timeframe data. 2) Entry signals reference bar[2] and bar[1] relative to current bar (0-indexed from most recent) - careful with index mapping in Python. 3) StopsLevel check requires broker-specific symbol info (SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL). 4) Lot reduction logic (DcF) iterates deal history backwards counting consecutive losses - need trade history access. 5) GlobalVariable persistence for tg1 needs to be replaced with in-memory state tracking. 6) The fallback SL/TP variant (SolveBuySLTP2/SolveSellSLTP2) adds complexity - primary levels must be validated against min stops before attempting trade. 7) SolveSellSLTP2 adds spread to SL/TP which is broker-dependent. 8) The entry signal is a specific candlestick pattern (penetration + recovery) not a simple indicator crossover - must be translated carefully.
